dialogues.speaker: Inna
dialogues.text: Hehe, so happy that Moo made a new friend...

dialogues.speaker: Inna
dialogues.text: He's a little Saurian from our tribe.

dialogues.speaker: Inna
dialogues.text: Ahh, he's not around here. Probably back at home playing with his new friend.

dialogues.speaker: Inna
dialogues.text: I think she's a kid from Fontaine. She's the wee small sort, and has a very cute nose...

dialogues.speaker: Inna
dialogues.text: Hehe, she's not a human and can't understand a word of what Moo's saying, but she seems to be getting along with him just fine.

dialogues.speaker: Inna
dialogues.text: I hope she stays a while to help Moo come out of his shell...

dialogues.speaker: Inna
dialogues.text: Hehe... I hope you can make some Saurian friends too!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You seem to care a lot about it.

dialogues.speaker: Inna
dialogues.text: Yeah! After all, they're our companions who live and fight by our side. We can't just think about our health alone, right?

dialogues.speaker: Inna
dialogues.text: Ah, I forgot to introduce myself. I'm a researcher, and I'm quite familiar with the way Saurians behave.

dialogues.speaker: Inna
dialogues.text: Some people call me the "Saurian Whisperer," but I don't actually understand their language. I just have a knack for observing how they behave and figuring out if they're sick or unhappy.

dialogues.speaker: Inna
dialogues.text: If you meet any Saurians that are behaving strangely, come find me. I'll do my best to help you pinpoint the problem and help find a solution.
